MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired Panasonic earbuds fit my previous headphone purchases and give me a compact option for laptop calls and personal listening.",
    "Recommending computer connectivity and audio products recognized parts of my interests, although only the earbuds met a clear current need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The tablets do not address a need I have expressed; owning a Kindle does not mean I want another portable screen.",
    "The streaming devices do not naturally follow from my Raspberry Pi project: buying parts for that project does not establish that I want a separate streaming device.",
    "The Echo Dot and smart plug assume an interest in voice-controlled home devices that my desk accessories and cable purchases do not establish.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender addresses a coverage problem I have not shown, while my recent adapter and cable choices support wired networking. The Bluetooth speaker likewise serves a different purpose from my personal-listening headphones."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My broad interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic device, regardless of what I would use it for.",
    "My Kindle and Amazon Basics purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in Amazon tablets, streaming devices, and Alexa products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest interactions center on maintaining a computer setup through wired networking, carrying equipment, organizing headphones, and cleaning hardware.",
    "I frequently choose accessories with a specific job for devices I already use; a related product needs to fill a practical gap rather than simply add another device.",
    "My purchases occur in groups around particular tasks, with long gaps between them, so an older entertainment project is weaker evidence of what I need now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed my current focus on practical accessories for maintaining and using my existing equipment."
}
